rationale: Genome-wide Brunello knockout screen in two HEK293 EIciGFP reporter lines (Yan et al. 2024, Genome Res): P-In reports the EIciPAIP2 circRNA, E-In the EIciEIF3J circRNA; GFP intensity tracks EIciRNA level. Cells were sorted into input (bulk), high-GFP (top 10%) and low-GFP (bottom 10%); one library per sort per reporter, no replicates, so the no-replicate path pools overdispersion over the non-targeting guides. The paper's main finding comes from the high-GFP group: knockouts that raise EIciRNA (hence GFP) are enriched in high-GFP versus input, identifying negative regulators of EIciRNA biogenesis (854 genes in P-In, 709 in E-In; 80 shared), among them eight RNA-splicing RBPs (SRSF1, SRSF2, HNRNPK, SNRNP70 named). SRSF1 was validated by shRNA knockdown. The enriched term of high-GFP vs input is read for each reporter.
